aliases: application react provider context wrapper global root
collisionPolicy: id must be unique across ui.providers; additive plugins must not claim a root provider id

verification.postcondition: the provider wraps the application root without a render error

minimalUsage: inject UI_PROVIDERS_SERVICE and lifecycle-own UiProviderRegistry.register through context.effect; use context.pluginId, context.generation, and a unique key

collisionPolicy: id must be unique across ui.background.tasks

verification.postcondition: the task is mounted and removed by lifecycle cleanup

minimalUsage: inject UI_BACKGROUND_TASKS_SERVICE and lifecycle-own UiBackgroundRegistry.register through context.effect with context.pluginId and context.generation
